summary: Blurs TOP images with kernel filters, pixel radii, multi-pass operation, and directional scaling across X, Y, or Z.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Kernel type: catmull, gaussian, box, bartlette, sinc, hanning, or blackman

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Edge handling: hold, repeat, or mirror

key_params.name: preshrink
key_params.note: Pre-shrink texture before large blur for performance

key_params.name: scale
key_params.note: Axis scale multiplied by filter size

key_params.name: dither
key_params.note: Dither 8-bit blur results to reduce banding

common_gotchas: Filter Size is in pixels, not normalized image units.
Large radii can be expensive; Pre-Shrink trades some quality for speed.
Extend mode strongly affects edge pixels during blur.
8-bit output can band unless dither or higher precision formats are used.
key_concepts: Blur TOP applies kernel filters such as Catmull-Rom, Gaussian, Box, Bartlette, Sinc, Hanning, and Blackman.
Filter Size is measured in pixels; expressions are needed for resolution-independent blur sizes.
Filter Scale and Sample Step can bias blur direction across X, Y, and Z axes.
Pre-Shrink improves large-blur performance by reducing texture resolution before blurring.
Dither can reduce visible banding in 8-bit blur results.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
